At the same time, the decision on the choice of certain processing parameters for the agent at each stage makes on the basis of the processing model. In turn, the processing model is a set of laws that associate with the selected processing options the obtained values of the intensity of the video stream as well as the magnitude of the error.

articleTitle: Models for Reduction of Interregional Disparities Accounting Regional Economic Security
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Deep regional and interregional disproportions determine the need to ensure sustainable socio-economic development. To achieve this aim, forms, methods and regulations for regional development have to be adjusted. The objective of the study is to create the parameters for state regulative influence on a number of identified socio-economic catalysts and retarders of the regions as well as to forecast the consequences of their influence, firstly, on the level of disparity of a particular region, and secondly, on the level of state socio-economic development, keeping in mind achievement of stable regional economic security. All possible variants of the system development are considered and the optimal management strategy for achievement desired goals is chosen. Obtained results allow avoiding undesirable consequences of state regulation and to develop the most effective complex of measures for regulating interregional disparities in Ukraine.

articleTitle: Signal Processing in UWB Subsurface Radiolocation by Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The signal processing problem for identification of underground objects is considered. The source of signals is the ultra short impulse electromagnetic waves reflected from air-ground interface and underground objects and received by subsurface radar antenna system. The source of the irradiated ultrawideband field is the plane electromagnetic wave with Gaussian time dependence that is incident normally to the air-ground interface. The numerical simulation of the electromagnetic problem to find the electrical field strength in receiving points above the ground at some fixed height is carried out by Finite Difference Time Domain method The received signals are processed by artificial neural networks for the object identification and classification of its position. The electrically small metal cylinder is used as an example of an object for the classification and recognition. The influence of the structure of an artificial neural network and its training peculiarities on the precision of the classification is investigated.

articleTitle: Specifics of Receiving and Processing Phase Information in Voice Authentication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The issues of improving the reliability of storing various resources, access to which is carried out using telecommunication networks, are considered. In this case, the first barrier in ensuring access reliability is the user authentication system. Lately, access systems based on biometric features of a user have been used. Initially, static biometric features of a user (facial image, finger papillary pattern and iris) were preferable, which did not meet the expectations of developers and users due to the simplicity of their falsification. Recently, the preference has been given to the dynamic (behavioral) biometric features of a user, namely voice authentication systems became more widely used. As it is known, voice authentication systems have several advantages, such as: simplicity, convenience, compactness, low cost, and a number of others. In addition, the passphrase can be quickly changed and expanded during the authentication process. However, the quality indicators of all biometric access systems do not meet the increasing requirements. The object of the study is the process of digital processing of voice signal during user authentication in access systems. In the process of voice authentication, the analysis of the amplitude-frequency spectrum of recording materials is performed. At the same time, the main research focuses on the use of estimates of formants, cepstral coefficients, mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, linear prediction coefficients, etc. as a user's template. On the basis of user's established patterns, admission decisions are made using Gaussian Mixture Models, Support Vector Machines, Hidden Markov Models or artificial neural networks. In the report, it is proposed to change the paradigm of digital processing of user voice signals and supplement the analysis of the amplitude-frequency spectrum with studies of phase data, which are traditionally ignored during the authentication. According to the authors, the latter is caused by the lack of effective procedures for the formation of phase data, the requirement of additional computational resources, which were not always available to researchers, and some features using the signal phase.

articleTitle: Steganographic Framework for Hiding a Color Image into Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In last years, steganography has been used for security purposes, the main idea is hide information inside some cover media, in such a way that it should be invisible to Human Visual System (HVS). In this paper, we propose a new steganography framework to hide a 24 bits color image inside digital images, where the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) is employed to reduce the amount of data representing secret image, and later, this new information is embedded into the middle-frequency DCT coefficients of the cover image, using the Quantization Index Modulation Dither-Modulation (QIM-DM). In experimental results, we have demonstrated that this technique supports JPEG compression attacks; also, the secret information is imperceptible to the human eye according to the obtained PSNR and SSIM values.

articleTitle: Shadow of Digital Economics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: the main purpose of this article is to analyze, discuss, and develop an approach to defining the shadow digital economy that accompanies worldwide digitalization processes. Digital economy implies total globalization, creates an ultra-high competitive environment, provides a new quality of life, business and public services. At the same time, many traditional areas of activity are being destroyed. In addition to understandable achievements, it is necessary to analyze new obvious and hidden threats that digitalization processes carry. An analysis of the causes and factors of the emergence and functioning of the new segment in the shadow economy is conducted. The approaches to the definition of this category and its content are discussed. A classification of criminal-oriented products and services that are the basis of a highly profitable illegal business has been proposed. The problem of confrontation with Shadow Digital Economics acquires particular urgency in the face of the emergence of new overt and hidden threats to the individuals, society and the state.

articleTitle: Classification of the Bee Colony Condition Using Spectral Features
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, the possibility of constructing a simple, in technical implementation, classification system based on the use of spectral features is shown. The efficiency of this system is demonstrated by an example of an analysis of the behaviour a bee colonies during honey collection using characteristics of noise inside the hive is explored. Analytical and mathematical models of information system for two classes recognition are considered: the honey collection and the complete cessation of honey harvest. Using eleven 1/3-octave filters, experimental studies were conducted to evaluate the power spectrum density of bee noise in the frequency range of 125-1250 Hz. Estimates of informative value of the power spectrum density values were obtained and the most informative values in the ranges of 200 Hz and 250 Hz were revealed. On this basis, the simulation of two classification systems was realized. In the first classification system, two values of power spectrum density estimates at frequencies of 200 Hz and 250 Hz were used as classification features. In this case, the equation of the dividing curve which separates the clusters of competing classes on the plane was used as a decision rule. In an alternative classification system, the power spectrum density estimate at the frequency of 200 Hz or 250 Hz was used as a classification feature, and the Bayesian strategy was used as the decision rule. Proposed classification systems were tested by means of estimation of correct classification probability on the training and testing data. This checking showed that the first classification system where two classification signs are used provides the correct classification probability of 0.81 for the training data, and of 0.96 for the testing data. Similar, although somewhat worse, results were obtained for the second kind of classification system where only one frequency band was used for classification sign measuring.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity as a Component of Information Security: A Terminological Aspect from the Point of View of the Ukrainian Information Legislation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The imperfection of definition of the essence of cybersecurity by the Ukrainian legislation is shown, the connection of cybersecurity and information security of the state is determined, the generalized definitions of the terms "cybersecurity" and "cyberspace" are given, the factors of cybersecurity threats are determined, based on its nature as a component of information security. These provisions can be applied to improve the information Ukrainian legislation, and also to develop the theory and practice of cybersecurity for the state, society, and human beings.

articleTitle: Using Kurtosis for Objective Assessment of the Musical Signals Clipping Degree
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: When transmitting music signals via infocommunication channels, there is a risk of distortion of these signals due to clipping. The consequence of these distortions is a decrease in subjective assessments of the quality of musical signals, so clipping detection is an important issue. In this paper, the kurtosis and the inverse value of kurtosis are proposed as measures of an objective assessment of the musical signals clipping degree. Matching maps of objective and subjective clipping degree estimates are monotonic functions that do not contain sharp kinks, which allow not only evaluating clipping degree, but also estimating music signals quality. An important advantage of the proposed measures of the clipping degree is the ability to simplify and speed up significantly the calculations due to the absence of the need of preliminarily estimation the probability density function of the analyzed musical signal.

articleTitle: Speech to Mind Map Conversion in Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The task of speech recognition and analysis is one of the most important in the modern infocommunication systems. Currently, a wide range of people doing business uses such systems. For rational use of time in carrying out planning or responsible negotiations, many modern companies use mind maps. Mind maps are a display of an effective way to think, remember, solve creative tasks and an opportunity to present and visually express the internal processes of information processing. However, the process of mind maps creating is not sufficiently automated; it requires special software and some time. Thus, the creation of memory cards requires a certain amount of human resources and in the case of an active discussion or speech, the actual memory card will be somewhat behind in time. Implementation of the infocommunication system proposed in the article will allow automating the process of speech to mind map conversion. Besides the fact that such a process proceeds in real time, the determination of the weight of separate nodes can be performed without human intervention, which will increase the objectivity of the result.

articleTitle: Estimation of a Coarse Synchronization Performance for Signals of Digital Television Systems Based on OFDM Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Article presents the results of research of the performance of coarse signal synchronization subsystem based on algorithm, which is typically used in OFDM-based digital television systems, in the presence of a signal offset in the time domain.

articleTitle: Decentralized Identification and Certification System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article describes an approach to identification and certification in decentralized environment. The protocol proposes a way of integration for blockchain technology and web-of-trust concept to create decentralized public key infrastructure with flexible management for user identificators. Besides changing the current public key infrastructure, this system can be used in the Internet of Things (IoT). Each individual IoT sensor must correctly communicate with other components of the system it's in. To provide safe interaction, components should exchange encrypted messages with ability to check their integrity and authenticity, which is presented by this scheme.

articleTitle: Method of Data Operative Control in the Residues Class
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article develops a method of data control in residues class, which, unlike the known ones, is based on the use of positional signs of the non-positional code, which increases the efficiency of data control in data transmission and processing system. Estimated data and comparative analysis of the efficiency of data control on the time of error detection and the number of control system equipment in residues class showed that with the growth of the digit grid of processed data the efficiency of non-position coding in the class of deductions increases significantly.

articleTitle: New Approaches to Modelling Covering Problems in Monitoring Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An issue of mathematical modeling in design of monitoring, diagnostic, and control systems is investigated. Mathematical models of the design problems reducible to covering of a circle object by circles are built. They are based on extracting a combinatorial structure of a new type connected with multipermutatons, on exploiting new geometric properties of objects involved, as well as on applying a continuous functional representation theory for modeling of the multipermutation set. Also, a Method of Artifical Space Dilation was used for constructing one of the mathematical models in extended space. This model is a global optimization one, which is the most promising in terms of obtaining a local optimum close to a global one. The models presented are generalized directly onto problems of covering a circular object by smaller circular objects that allows to cover a much wider class of the design problems regarding their mathematical modeling and solving by continuous and discrete optimization methods.

articleTitle: Determining the Level of Importance for Critical Information Infrastructure Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Today world leading states began to focus on methods and tools of identifying, systematizing and securing critical infrastructure objects. The loss or failure of normal functioning of these objects will lead to significant or even irreparable negative consequences for the national security. For the application of adequate protection methods, it is important to determine the level of importance (criticality) of the state information infrastructure in a certain sphere. From this viewpoint, method for determining the level of importance for critical information infrastructure objects in civil aviation was developed in this paper. This method uses following procedures: introducing the base set of systems and corresponding subsets of subsystems, components, functions, violations of work continuity (interruptions of work), their features and consequences, and also the construction of a three-dimensional matrix of criticality as well as calculation of additional weighting factors of criticality. Proposed method makes it possible to assess the level of importance and rank critical aviation information system both quantitative and qualitative parameters. Moreover, the technique for conducting an experiment, by which the adequacy of the response to change the input data are verified, which confirmed the ability to determine the level of importance of critical aviation information systems for various categories was developed.

articleTitle: Clans Aggregation for Verification of Networking Protocols on Parallel Architectures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Petri nets represent a convenient and powerful tool for networking protocols verification as a basic task of cybersecurity domain. Composition of clans speeds-up process of protocols verification reduced to solving linear Diophantine systems. Varying minimal clan size brings in certain imbalance when solving a system on parallel architectures using PaAd software. The present paper studies a task of preliminary balancing the clan size via their aggregation represented as a special case of graph partitioning. Variants of the task are considered and solved using heuristic techniques: a fast bin packing with the first fit on a sorted array algorithm and a multi-objective graph partitioning with software package METIS. A case study for the clans aggregation on TCP and IOTP protocols and hypertorus communication structures shows that aggregation of clans brings in an additional 3 times speed-up.

articleTitle: Research on Wavelet Filter Features for Nonstationary Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to detection and analysis of wavelet filter features for nonstationary signals with time-varying characteristics. The actual problem of complex wavelet estimation is described. The wavelet coefficients responsiveness to the signal frequencies is shown. This technique allows determining the signal frequency passbands using the optimal fitting wavelet basis. The software implementing this method is presented. These methods are applied to the problem of waviness and roughness profile allocation of metal surfaces treated by milling and they could also be used for any types of nonstationary data such as telecommunication signals, satellite navigation, medicine data, financial series, etc.

articleTitle: Microprocessor System of Determining the Intensity of Traffic
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article describes the basic principles of traffic monitoring. The basis of traffic monitoring information systems are visual observers and sensors of traffic parameters. The current traffic sensors show unsatisfactory results in the conditions of intensive vehicle traffic, parking of the vehicle on the traffic lane, visual overlapping of the traffic sensor vehicle and when moving the vehicle between lanes. The article proposes a system architecture using Hall sensors to collect primary vehicle traffic information. The hardware implementation of the prototype of the data processing unit of the system has been developed and the possibility of applying the magnetic resonance effect to determine the traffic intensity of vehicles has been experimentally proved.

articleTitle: QoE Optimization Technique for Media Delivery in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: QoE is almost the most important parameter, estimating which it is possible to determine user experience and compare it with users' expectations. Nowadays mobile networks bring a lot of new possibilities for business, industry etc. In this situation a lot of services and applications appear. And one of the most growing area is multimedia delivery in 5G networks. That's why it is necessary to develop new QoE improvement methods, which can take into account features of very different types of traffic in modern mobile networks architecture. Such method and scheme how to realize it on practice are presented in this paper. This architecture was developed within the 5G-Xcast project and its main goal to achieve necessary QoE in dynamic 5G environment for multimedia delivery. For this purpose several solutions (multilink, mABR, QUIC, MooD) can be used.

articleTitle: Models and Methods of IT and Infocommunications Portfolio Management Using the System of Metrics and KPIs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article explores the reasons for the need of using key performance indicators (KPI's) to achieve strategic goals of the organization, analyzes the reasons for the need to monitor and control investments in the development of the organization's technology, analyzes the interrelation and use of metrics for regular and timely monitoring and controlling of achievement of the organization's KPI's. On specific examples, financial metrics of the portfolio of infocommunication projects are considered, which in combination can reflect the real picture of achievement of the target KPI's of the organization, as well as the quality of infocommunication projects portfolio of the organization as a whole. It is analyzed in detail how one can interpret the values of the metrics of the portfolio of infocommunication projects, and in which cases it is necessary to take corrective actions. The close and integrated relationship between the metric system, reflecting assessment of the current processes of implementing products and services, established targets, is explained in detail. Conclusions are made about trends in metrics and performance indicators for the implementation of infocommunication projects and their impact on business development and the sphere as a whole.

articleTitle: Statistical Simulation of Size Behavior for TCP Windows
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The methods for statistical simulation of Poisson and Wiener random processes are studied in the paper. The algorithms for simulation of a Wiener process are based on its spectral representation. There are constructed models with given reliability and accuracy. The algorithm for simulation of a Poisson process relies on the distribution of the intervals between jump times of the process. Stochastic models of data transmission and network traffic are widely used in the design and operation of data networks. These models allow us to estimate traffic losses and identify ways to improve service quality. Different approaches and methods for managing network overload, including Random Early Detection algorithms, are used in data networks. The Random Early Detection algorithm allows controlling the loading of the router's queue and, under determining the overload, carrying out the dropping of packets with some probability. The reset of a package is based on probability calculation. The algorithm is oriented towards working with Transmission Control Protocol, so dropping packets allows the load source to reduce the size of the window and, thus, to reduce the load. The model of a network behavior is described by stochastic differential equations. In the paper, there are constructed solutions for such equations. For simulation of realizations of stochastic differential equations, their representation in the form of difference equation and statistical models of Poisson and Wiener random processes are used. The simulation results are used to control the size of Transmission Control Protocol windows.

articleTitle: One-Periodic Template Marks Model of Normal Behavior of the Safety Parameters of Information Systems Networking Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to improvement cyber-attacks recognition systems on network resources of information systems. By analogy with the classification of technical systems failures, it is proposed to select a class of step-by-step cyber-attacks that are characterized by a long and expected, from the point of view of the information security system, process of changing security parameters to values that exceed the safe limits. The approach to the recognition of progressive cyber-attacks is grounded. It involves estimating the deviation of the current values of the safety parameters from the patterns of normal behaviour, calculated over a given operation interval. The need for improving the existing patterns by adapting them to the typical non-stationary nature of the dynamics of security parameters is shown. The Markov model of a one-period model of normal behaviour was developed and verified, which allows the approximation of dynamics safety parameters in case of its one-time non-stationary. The expediency of carrying out of further researches in the direction of development of a multi-periodic template Markov model of safety parameters normal behaviour is shown.

articleTitle: The Mathematical Model of the Optimal Choice of a Software Package for an Enterprise Information System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The mathematical definition of the optimal choice problem for software package for an enterprise information system is considered. The problem of the optimal software package choice is a mathematical model of combinatorial optimization on a set of combinations. The algorithm for solving this problem is presented for finding the minimum value of the target function considering additional linear constraints. This method makes it possible to significantly simplify the finding procedure of the optimal solution, since inequalities in the growth of constraints allow us to immediately determine whether a point in the set of combinations will be a support solution or not. In the positive case, the support solution is improved, taking into account the properties of many combinations when directly checking the growth of the target function. The algorithm and its realization are demonstrated by a numerical example. The proposed mathematical model and solution algorithm can be used for a similar class of problems that are modeled by optimization models, where the set of feasible solutions is presented in the many combinations form.

articleTitle: Sensing Properties of SRR: Influence of Finger Touching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the sensing properties of split ring resonator (SRR). The response of SRR on finger touching of different areas of the structure was studied by simulation and experiment. The investigations depict an influence of a finger on the value of SRR resonances that can be explained by the changing of total capacitance value. The obtained results shown that the top side of the investigated SRR is very sensitive due to direct contact with metallic strips and the range of resonance moving is very wide (from 0.505 to 1.084 GHz). Instead, the acceptable resonance response was achieved for the interaction through a dielectric substrate where the value of resonance changing is from 0.909 to 1.074 GHz.

articleTitle: Estimating the Hurst Exponent of Fractional Levy Motion by the Fractional Moments Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Model of fractional Levy motion has been studied. As it was shown, conventional methods for estimating the Hurst exponent are based on second-order statistics, so are inapplicable to the processes with heavy tails. Applying the method of fractional moments, makes it possible to estimate Hurst exponent both for heavy-tailed processes and for processes with long-range dependence. The proposed method is very simple in software implementation, which is its undoubted advantage. Numerical simulations were made and numerical results are in accordance with analytic ones.

articleTitle: Semantic Processing of Radar Spectral Information for Air Object Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The results of the study of semantic processing of spectral information in the intelligent radar systems are presented. A method for formalizing the processes of perception and transformation of spectral images based on algebra of finite predicates is developed. A model for semantic processing of spectral image for surveillance radars has been developed and implemented. To analyze the features of clutter spectra and air object signals authors investigate the decision making algorithms of a human-operator. Spectral pattern is described as a predicate on the set of spectral channels that exceed the certain threshold value. The predicates-signs are introduced to indentify spectral types. Instantaneous spectrum is corresponded to one type of spectrum by a combination of these predicates. A functional diagram for automatic identification of spectral types, based on these equations, is built. The algorithm for analyzing of the clutter spectrum and recognizing of the air objects, based on algebra of finite predicates, which is proposed in the paper, allows to define all signs and automatically recognize air objects in real time.

articleTitle: Malware Classification Using Distance and Directional Local Binary Patterns
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Nowadays, malware is one of the biggest cyber threats faced by a common user to a large company, since almost any electronic device is susceptible to an infection due to this type of threat. In addition, malwares continue growing in frequency and sophistication where the identification and classification of the classic and new variants of different malware families is a difficult task that requires modern detection techniques. In this paper, a malware classification method based on two novel local binary pattern descriptors and convolutional neural network, which represents malware binary files as gray-scale images, is presented. The proposed method exploits the fact that most malware variants in the same family have similar local and global structures, therefore, the computing of the local binary descriptors of the gray-scale images facilitates the detection and classification of the variants of a malware. Experimental results have shown that the proposed method outperforms previous related schemes in terms of accuracy resulting in of about 98 %.

articleTitle: The Influence of an Information Environment on Consumer Behavior in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper deals with the mechanism of luxury second-hand goods pricing as a reaction to an information background a consumer operates in. It was proved that search query trends as an indicator of digital information background are a significant factor for customers to establish prices. This economic phenomenon explains the necessity to protect open data sources from corruption. Poor data quality and lack of data transparency might have negative effects on both companies and customers decision-making process.

articleTitle: Infocommunication Provision for the Production of Entomophages
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work is devoted to the creation of infocommunication provision for the production of entomophages, in particular, use of information resources and means of interaction in the process of formation of production management strategies; the object of research was the processes of production of entomophages; the scientific novelty of the work is that, using the infocommunication approach, methods of structural synthesis and expert evaluation, in order to increase the efficiency of the production of entomophages, an infocommunication provision has been developed, components of which are of information provision (the structure of the goals of the production of entomophages; factors which results in an entomological substandard products and diagrams of their significance) and communication provision implemented by a two-tier computer-integrated system, the lower level of which is represented by an automatic subsystem of control of the abiotic parameters of the phased development of insects (temperature and relative humidity of air) on the basis of a personal computer, the meter-regulator TRM202 OWEN, the SCADA program OWEN PROCESS MANAGER, the automatic converter USB / RS-485 interface, temperature sensors and relative humidity air; the upper level - an intellectual subsystem of decision-making, which contains the MATLAB user interface, the knowledge base and the logical conclusion module database; the proposed approaches allow for more specific work on the definition of management strategies and is a new solution in the development of intelligent technologies for managing the production of entomological plant protection products.

articleTitle: Comparing Performances of Cypress Block Cipher and Modern Lighweight Block Ciphers on Different Platforms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the comparison of performance of prospective lightweight block cipher Cypress with performances of the known modern lightweight block ciphers such as AES, SPECK, SPARX etc. The measurement was done on different platforms: Windows, Linux and Android. On all platforms selected, the block cipher Cypress showed the best results. The block cipher Cypress-256 showed the highest performance on Windows x32 (almost 3.5 Gbps), 64-bit Linux (over 8 Gbps) and Android (1.3 Gbps). On Windows x64 the best result was obtained by Cypress- 512 (almost 5 Gbps).

articleTitle: Method of Arithmetic Comparison of Data in the Residue Numeral System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article considers the method of arithmetic comparison of numbers in the residue numeral system (RNS). The use of RNS significantly increases the speed of implementation of modular arithmetic operations. However, the implementation of non-modular operations in RNS requires the development of effective methods for comparing numbers. The mathematical model and the method of arithmetic comparison of numbers, proposed in the paper, are based on the usage of the positional feature of the non-positional code in RNS. This method ensures the maximum accuracy of comparison with a minimum number of equipment of the comparing device. Also, the developed method is more effective in comparing numbers compared to a method that is based on the operation of zeroing numbers. Using the developed method expands the field of effective use of RNS as a number system of computing systems.

Author Keywords: non-positional numeral system in residual classes
mathematical model and method of arithmetic comparison of integers

articleTitle: Modeling Cyber Security of Information Systems Smart City Based on the Theory of Games and Markov Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article considers some aspects of modeling information security circuits for information and communication systems used in Smart City. As a basic research paradigm, the postulates of game theory and mathematical dependencies based on Markov processes were used. Thus, it is possible to sufficiently substantively describe the procedure for selecting rational variants of cyber security systems used to protect information technologies in Smart City. At the same time, using the model proposed by us, we can calculate the probability of cyber threats for the Smart City systems, as well as the cybernetic risks of diverse threats. Further, on the basis of the described indicators, rational contour options are chosen to protect the information systems used in Smart City.

articleTitle: Limitations of Efficiency of Wireless Systems of Telecommunications 5G and Methods of Their Compensation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article analyzes the approaches to the mathematical modeling of promising telecommunication systems in the millimeter wavelength range. The advantages and limitations of the use of the millimeter wave range are analyzed. It has been proposed in the models for calculating the energy budget of radio channels to take into account the limiting and compensating factors that are characteristic of radio systems in the millimeter range. A comparative analysis of models for calculating the budget of radio lines based on the Friis formula, the quasi-optical model, and the theory of phased antenna arrays is carried out. It is shown that increasing the energy efficiency of telecommunication systems in the millimeter range requires fundamentally new approaches to modeling radio channels.

articleTitle: Mathematical Support of the Information System for Managing the Technological Process of Polymerization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The mathematical support of the information system of the polymerization process for the obtaining products with specified properties has been developed. The basis of this informational system is a mathematical model of heterogeneous-catalytic co-oligomerization of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub> fraction of pyrolysis liquid products. The model allows to determine the rational technological regimes of the process and optimal composition of the raw material, to regulate the operational characteristics of the reaction products at the stage of their synthesis and to obtain co-oligomers with predicted properties. The focus is on the polymer yield, the molecular weight and the bromine number. The main factors influencing this process are catalyst concentration, temperature and time. This mathematical support is intended for introduction of automation of technological process.

articleTitle: Software-Based Contact Debouncing Algorithm with Programmable Auto-Repeat Profile Feature
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A novel engineering software-based solution for contact debounce in embedded systems is proposed by dint of a specialized finite-state machine. A cross-platform C-language implementation of algorithm in conjunction with maintain data structures description is shown. Independence of hardware is guaranteed by using of pointer to port read function. An integration paradigm into existing embedded project is given. An auto-repeat feature allows emulating of unique repetition behavior in case of long pushing state. Proposed algorithm guaranties the robust input data and excludes the influence of unsuccessful mechanical implementation of any type of input devices with contacts.

articleTitle: Security Technique for Authentication Process in the Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Cloud technology is a prospective field of information technology. Moreover, this development is always accompanied by a variety of vulnerabilities that are exploited by malicious people to access data stored in cloud environment. Data protection is one of the most challenging issues of cybersecurity. Since many companies have decided to store their data in cloud services, it is extremely important to provide information security in general. Thus, the most vulnerable point is the authentication process. In this paper the requirements for information technology protection based on SRP protocol were defined. Also the architecture of next generation data center based on cloud computing was developed.

articleTitle: Factorial Permutation Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Permutations are widely used in practice for solving problems of combinatorial optimization, noise-resistant coding, as well as in modern methods of protecting information as their structural elements. The paper poses the problem of accelerating the search of permutations with a changing interval between them in increasing or decreasing order. To solve this problem, we propose a method of permutations searching with a change in its direction and interval between permutations, using factorial numbers. The fundamentals of the factorial numbers theory are presented and a method for obtaining them is given. Examples of addition operations between factorial numbers are given. An improved method for converting factorial numbers into permutations is considered. It is shown that the proposed method of permutations searching has increased speed due to the use of arithmetic operations of addition and subtraction of factorial numbers, and also allows to change the direction of permutations searching, which increases its flexibility. Due to its simplicity and regularity of the structure, the proposed method is effective for both software and hardware implementations. It is promising for solving problems both with a complete enumeration of all their solutions, and with partial ones.

articleTitle: Experimental Researches on Determination of Angles of Side Illumination by Laser Radiation of Optical Devices and Optoelectronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work is devoted to the research of laser illumination of optical and electronic means of observation and intelligence of military and civilian use. The purpose of the research was to experimentally determine the angles of lateral illumination by laser radiation of optical-electronic means, taking into account the features of the design and modes of adjustment of the lenses, which cause a significant loss of information component obtained in real time. Known open publications in this area do not fully reflect the dynamics of the effects of laser radiation, and highlight the ultimate maximum effect of dazzle or have finite energy performance lesions to the receiving matrices of optoelectronic means. The results obtained by the method of physical experiment showed that the value of the side-illumination angle depends on the design of the lens. The angle of side illumination increases, depending on the increase in the field of view of the lens, the greater the angle between the optical axis of the lens and the tangent to its body (the constructive surface of the external lens). Side illumination also depends on the presence of protective glass, which scans laser radiation and, as a consequence, affects the regular operation of optoelectronic devices. The results obtained can be used as initial data in the military sphere - in solving problems of counteraction to opto-electronic means; law enforcement experts, developers of optical devices and opto-electronic devices, as well as specialists in telecommunications specialties - in solving the problems of protection of video surveillance systems, etc.

Author Keywords: field of view of the lens

articleTitle: A New Approach to Quantifying the Perceived Contrast of Complex Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Extensive use of video content in various applications requires a solution to the problem of no-reference quantifying perceived contrast of an image. However, known methods of measuring integral contrast in an image have several disadvantages that significantly limit their use to quantify perceived contrast. In this paper, the problem of improving the accuracy of quantifying perceived contrast for complex multi-element images was considered. A new approach to no-reference quantifying the perceived contrast of the image was proposed. The proposed approach is based on the measurement of perceived contrast in the a reference image with a limited dynamic range, for which Weber-Fechner's law is valid, with subsequent correction of the measurement result taking into accounts the mean for the ratios between the contrast values of the pairs of objects in the reference and the source image. Based on this approach, a new technique for quantifying the perceived image contrast was proposed. Possible implementations of this technique for complete and incomplete integral contrast using weighted and relative contrast kernels proposed. Research confirms the effectiveness of the proposed approach to quantifying the perceived contrast of complex images.

articleTitle: Excitation of the Wave TE01 in a Circular Waveguide by Means of the Higher Oscillations of an Open Resonator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper analyses the excitation efficiency of the TE01 wave in a segment of the circular waveguide that is made in the center of one of the mirrors of the open resonator (OR) with the help of the higher order modes ТЕМ11q (in the Lagerr-Gauss functions) and TEM30q (in the Hermite-Gauss functions) and the degenerate mode TEM*11q. All calculations were carried out taking into account the vector nature of the electric field. The analysis results established that the maximum excitation efficiency of the TE01 wave in a circular waveguide using the TEM11q mode is 0.161. The excitation efficiency of the same wave using the TEM30q oscillation is equal to 0.121. When the considered wave was excited by using only the central part of the TEM*11q mode (in the Lagerr-Gauss functions) the maximum excitation efficiency of the TE01 wave grew up to 1. The maximum excitation efficiency of the same wave with the help of the central part of the TEM*11q oscillation (in the Hermite-Gauss functions) is slightly lower and amounts to 0.954. The amplitude distribution of the field of the considered wave takes the form of a ring in the mirror of the OR.

articleTitle: Application of Spatial Signal Processing for Bandwidth Capability Improvement of Radio Relay Link
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Novel method of radio relay link bandwidth capacity improvement based on spatial signal processing by the wave front of the electromagnetic wave are presented. Test results of a variant of one-hop simplex radio relay link lab prototype with spatial signal processing both in the transmitting and receiving sites are shown. This prototype provides simultaneous parallel wireless transmission of two DVB-C radio signals with 64-QAM modulations at bit rates of 41.25 Mbps over 8 MHz bandwidth with the same carrier frequency of 10.56 GHz and with the same electromagnetic waves polarization at distance of 8 meters. This prototype can be used for research the possibility of radio frequency resource reuse and bandwidth capability improvement for radio relay links by applying spatial signal processing techniques.

articleTitle: Research Queuing System with Hypererlangian Distributions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of a queuing system (QS) with second-order hypererlangian input distributions relating to systems of an arbitrary type, with the aim of obtaining a solution for the average waiting time for queued requirements. For this, the classical method of spectral decomposition of the solution of the Lindley integral equation is used. For practical application of the obtained results, the method of moments is used. It turns out that the second-order hyperelangian distribution law, which is three-parameter, as well as the hyperexponential law, can be determined by both the first two moments and the first three moments. The choice of such a law of probability distribution is due to the fact that its coefficient of variation covers a wider range than at the hyperexponential law of distribution. The method of spectral decomposition of the solution of the Lindley integral equation for a queuing system with hyperlangian input distributions allows one to obtain a solution in closed form. In the scientific literature, including Internet resources, the authors did not find results on such a system. However, these results are in demand in modern teletraffic theory.

articleTitle: The Use of Fractal Signals in Information and Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A mathematical model for the formation of a fractal signal based on van der Pol non-linear differential equations is proposed. The formation of the structure of fractal signals is based on the self-similarity hypothesis, which allows an infinite series of embedding identical (homeomorphic) vibrations into each other. The property of hyperbolicity in the formation of a fractal signal using reference harmonic oscillations is to compress (decrease) the amplitude and stretch (increase) the frequency. Based on models of a fractal signal, it is possible to build forming signals with variable parameters. The fundamental possibility of using a fractal signal as an information signal carrier, i.e. a fractal signal is used as a masking signal. The parameters of the fractal signal are agreed (selected) with the participation of all interested parties. The fractal carrier signal has a wider range of parameters, which, in addition to amplitude, frequency and initial phase, include: the scaling factor (similarity), as well as the number and parameters of harmonic components involved in the formation of the signal. The specific parameters and properties of a fractal signal that distinguish it from classical radio signals allow it to be used to increase the availability of transmitted information. The fractal signal allows the generators to be identical on the receiving side of the system.

articleTitle: Use of Information Technologies for Clinical Decision-Making in Medical Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Use of modern information technologies in medical diagnosis is considered for making clinical decisions in the medical rehabilitation (MR). Main parameters necessary for making optimal clinical solutions are distinguished. Method developed in compliance with the general algorithm of the decisionmaking theory is applied for making specific rehabilitation programs [6]. Probability of making diagnosis in the presence of symptoms is assessed by means of the Bayes theorem. Potential and real models of clinical solutions are presented, as well as the general algorithm of decision-making for rehabilitation intervention (patient's history, clinical diagnosis specification, assessment of morphometry measurements, assessment of functional capabilities, choice of the alternative, indication/contraindication for rehabilitation. In the absence of contraindications: identifying tasks, means, rehabilitation methods, determining motion state and load parameters). With this in view in-depth theoretical analysis of this problem in Ukraine and abroad is carried out.

articleTitle: A Model for Choosing Hosting for a Company’s Website
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper analyzes the problem of choosing the best hosting for a company’s website. A generalized model for choosing hosting for a company’s website is developed. It is proposed to decompose the generalized problem into subproblems: choosing an effective type of hosting, choosing the optimal hosting provider and rational tariff plan. There built a model for choosing a virtual dedicated server (VDS), which allows, unlike the existing ones, to select a hosting provider’s tariff plan for a VDS to place a company’s website using multiple functional and cost criteria.

articleTitle: Impact Evaluation of Embedded Security Mechanisms on System Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Experience in designing general-purpose systems that enforce security goals shows that achieving universality, security, and performance remains a very difficult challenge. As a result, two directions emerged in designing, one of which focused on universality and performance with limited security mechanisms, and another - on robust security with reasonable performance for limited sets of applications. In the first case, popular but unsecure systems were created, and various efforts were subsequently made to upgrade the protected infrastructure for such systems. In the work, the latter approach is considered. It is obvious that the inclusion of built-in security mechanisms leads to a decrease in system performance. The paper considers a reference monitor and the assessment of its impact on system performance. For this purpose, the functional structure of reference monitor is built and the analytical model of impact evaluation on system performance is proposed.

Author Keywords: impact evaluation analytical model of reference monitor

articleTitle: Methods of Providing Information Security of a Multimedia Publishing Company
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the present work an author provided methodical fundamentals of providing information security of a multimedia publishing company in the process of added value formation. The study considers the value added of multimedia publishing as the difference between publishing output and intermediate consumption. It is proposed to allocate the parameters that affect the value added, to study the mechanism of its formation and selection of parameters in order to maximize the added value of multimedia publishing.On account of mathematical programming tools, the author solved the task of elaborating the financial development program of a multimedia publishing company. Based on the use of the system dynamics method, the simulation model of added value formation of a multimedia publishing company was created. The researcher studied the risk management issue of a multimedia publishing company. In order to understand the model's efficiency and its appropriateness in the company's operation process it is necessary to conduct a computer experiment with the model on the set of initial data in the Vensim PLE 5.0 environment.

articleTitle: Simulation Technologies in Raiding Countering for Ensuring the Economic Security of the Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper proposes the simulation modelling techniques to evaluating the impact of threat parameters to the risk of the enterprise raider seizure. The modelling of the possibility of the raider seizure under the threat conditions acts as a prerequisite for the management decisions formation to ensure of the enterprise economic security and is based on the simulation models of dependence of the overall q-Tobin indicator (by the value of the elasticity coefficient) on a set of the coefficients characterizing of the threat parameters of the raider seizure The implementation of this approach allowed us to create a more reasoned analytical and practical basis for ensuring of the enterprises economic security in a targeted, systematic and adequate of counteracting raiding in the context of the crisis tendencies of a destabilizing nature.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Passive Fragments Influence in Broadband Signals with Manipulated Information Entropy on the Data Transmission Reliability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Current methods of digitally processing communication signals, which are distorted in the computer systems communication channels, are often based on the use of amplitude, phase and spectral characteristics. Correlation methods are also used to ensure immunity. A common disadvantage of these methods is the need for significant computational cost. One of the partial solutions to the described problem may be to use the signals probabilistic characteristics, in particular information entropy. This approach is based on the representation of digital message bits to the corresponding fragments of broadband signals with manipulated information entropy. In fact, signals are formed on the basis of random processes with normal distribution of possible states. The use of passive fragments in such signals can reduce the energy cost of data transmission. When passing through a communication channel, passive fragments are filled with their own channel noise. As a result, the channel's own noise extends the number of possible signal amplitude states and can be used to improve the resolution. According to the results of studies, the dependence of the probability of distortion of the information message binary symbol on the normalized signal/noise ratio is obtained. It is shown that the use of passive fragments improves noise immunity by 3-4 dB within the normalized signal/noise ratio at the input from -5 dB to 14 dB. However, at 14 dB or more, noise immunity worsens. Thus, the main scope of the proposed method can be problematic channels with low signal/noise ratio.

articleTitle: Recognition of Interior Objects from Photographs and Their Subsequent Transformation into a Drawing for Building Iot Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article discusses a system to accelerate the construction of IoT systems of a smart home, by recognizing interior objects from photographs of the house, with their subsequent transformation into a drawing for manipulating all recognized objects. Various neural network frameworks were considered such as: Apache Spark, TensorFlow, Caffe, as well as methods for recognition: Adam (Adaptive Moment Estimation), methods for optimizing multi-dimensional problems, the backpropagation algorithm. The structure of the system, its components, as well as the operation algorithm are shown. The experiment shows one of the cases with photographs that are taken at an angle and in low light. The experiment demonstrates the program cycle, uploading photos, selecting point of angles, recognizing room objects. As a result, we see the program interface in which a drawing with all recognized objects that we can manipulate, add various elements, such as temperature sensors, various other sensors (lights, etc.) and servos, and with hardware and software for their control.

articleTitle: The Information Signal Resonance Effect Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The economic system is considered as an oscillating system with its own frequencies, which can be included in various types of resonance with information signals from the external environment. The model of the stock market and the example of the stochastic resonance of the RTS index under the influence of information "white noise" are presented. It is proposed to consider the resonance impact on the financial indicators of the economic system as an information weapon in the competitive struggle. Taking into account the possibility of "information aggression" against the economic system, it is proposed to include in the list of indicators of the "crisis field" the "information threat level".

articleTitle: Compensation for Color Distortions in End-to-End Video Transmission Paths with Regards to the Spectral Composition of Light Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents the results of color perception modeling, taking into account the spectral distribution of light sources and the spectral properties of light-signal converters. The results show that a bandpass filter, whose effect on the original colors of the scene elements leads to a shift in the chromaticity coordinates, can model the spectral characteristics of the light-signal transducers. The spectral properties of the light sources at the transmitting and receiving side can be simulated by convolution with the output spectra of the photosensitive arrays, and the combined effect can lead to a shift in color coordinates that exceed the color difference thresholds. The calculations of the maximum shifts for sources of daylight illumination, incandescent lamps and fluorescent sources are given. It is proposed to include in the path from light to light-special signals that correct color shifts.

articleTitle: Method of Radar Adjustment with Automatic Dependent Surveillance Technology Use
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The subject of study in the article is the method of radar adjustment. The goal of the article is to develop a method of radar adjustment with automatic dependent surveillance technology use. The analysis of known radar adjustment methods, analysis of factors affecting the accuracy of airspace coordinates, analysis of automatic dependent surveillance technology capabilities, development method of radar adjustment with automatic dependent surveillance technology use were considered. The following results were given. The possibility of application of automatic dependent surveillance technology for the increase the accuracy of determination coordinates of air objects is established. The scientific novelty of the results obtained is as follows: increasing the accuracy of radar adjustment achieved through the automatic dependent surveillance technology use.

articleTitle: Models of Information Processing in IoT Networks on the Basis of Fundamental Trigonometric Splines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The approach to increase the efficiency of information processing in wireless networks on the basis of the proposed mathematical model is considered. This model is based on fundamental trigonometric splines. The construction of trigonometric splines is shown, as well as the smoothness properties of trigonometric splines, which are important at the stage of construction of these models. The method of the information signal reproduction in the communication system by interpolation of the digital signal, using the fundamental trigonometric spline is proposed. It has been shown that the use of trigonometric splines will allow the reproduction of information signals with less error. The estimation of the complexity of the algorithm for constructing trigonometric splines is compared with the existing ones. An important scientific problem was solved, which consists in improving the methods of information processing in the Internet of Things based on fundamental trigonometric splines.

articleTitle: Method for Accessing and Processing Multimedia Content in a Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Various voice assistants were analyzed and Alexa was selected as the best one. For the first time a voice skill was developed that works with cloud environment, and also works with files and loses them in the column Echo Dot. The development peculiarity is to describe the interaction with Alexa in the JSON file format and the programming of the AWS Lambda service, which is proposed to replace the implementation on Ruby on Rails to reduce the processing time of the request, with the hosting (hosting) in the same skill implementation service. At the moment there are no similar skills and voice assistants.

articleTitle: The Information Controlling Model Transport System During Transient Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to designing an information management system for the conveyor line of mining enterprises. The analytical design method for the transient mode of the stepped speed control system of the conveyor line was developed. The partial differential equation was used in constructing the conveyor line model. The description of the production system is fulfilled in the single step approximation. A decision was obtained which determines the state of the parameters of the production line for a technological position specified as a function of time. Has been determined the length of the transition period during which the initial condition for the distribution of labor objects along the conveyor affects the parameters of the state of the conveyor line. The method for calculating the current parameters of a conveyor line with the use of partial differential equations allows the design of control systems for production lines of conveyor type for transient modes. The originality of the results obtained is to improve the PDE-models of the conveyor-type production systems used to design highly efficient production control systems operating in transient modes.

articleTitle: Statistical Simulation and Processing of Self-Similar Traffic
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the article methods of statistical simulation of fractional Brownian motion are investigated. The fractional Brownian motion is a process with stationary increments, which is constructed in the form of a Gaussian stationary process. With the help of the developed method, the implementations of self-similar traffic of telecommunication networks are simulated. On the real data, a statistical analysis of traffic was performed and the adequacy of the model based on the fractional Brownian motion was checked.

articleTitle: Creating the Information Basis of Spectral Masks for Automated Radiomonitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The report presents the results of developing a method for constructing, experimentally checking and creating an information basis for spectral masks for transmitters of basic digital and analog radio technologies. The source data for the construction of spectral masks was a sample of radio electronic devices (RED) types from a database of frequency assignments that differ either by the range of operating frequencies, either by the radiation class, or by the type of modulating data code. A database of spectral masks and an algorithm for their construction was developed on the basis of tabular data. The software product allows the formation of a dynamic list of spectral masks, for visual and convenient work with the developed database (DB) of transmitting devices. His application made it possible to construct spectral masks for transmitting devices of basic digital and analog radio technologies. For integration into the spectrum analyzers, the possibility of mass translation of table values into the necessary formats is provided.

articleTitle: Properties of Hyperexponential and Hypererlangian Distributions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article considers two laws of distribution: hyperexponential and hypererlangian as input distributions for queuing systems. These two laws of distribution belong to a general form with a wide range of variation of the coefficients of variation. The main unique feature of these laws of distributions consists that they can unambiguously be defined by both two first initial moments, and three moments. An approach to the approximation of arbitrary distribution laws by these laws is proposed both at the level of two initial moments and at the level of three moments. The considered laws of distributions, starting from some values of the coefficients of variation, have a heavy tail, and, consequently, in queuing systems they will give a greater delay than other laws of distributions. Practical calculations show that approximation using two moments gives somewhat underestimated results in terms of average waiting time. The use of these laws of distributions in the queueing theory extends and complements the well-known incomplete formula for the average waiting time for systems of mass service with arbitrary laws of the distribution of intervals of input requirements and service time. The results obtained are important for modern teletraffic theory.

articleTitle: 3D Intellectual Heuristic Topology of Communication Devices of Telecommunication Structures on the Elements by Berezovsky
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The models of the topology of information tunnels with the number of channels n≥1 of telecommunication systems in the polar coordinate system using switching patterns on Berezovsky's elements, as well as the introduction of retaining rings as points of decentralized control / access to the "tunnel" information, which in general can be represented as a digital double, are considered.

articleTitle: Stochastic Frontier Analysis and Wavelet Ideology in the Study of Emergence of Threats in the Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Financial markets are an important structural element of the economy. These markets make it possible to mobilize and reallocate financial resources. However, such a process is constantly under the threat of various risks. To prevent and minimize risks, it is necessary to use a comprehensive procedure for analyzing the conditions for occurrence of such risks. To this end, we examined the interrelationship of stochastic frontier analysis and wavelet ideology. We emphasize the link between technical efficiency and the possible occurrence of risks. For an advanced analysis of the conditions of occurrence of risk, we use the apparatus of the theory of wavelets. The results are given on the example of real data for the banking sector of the economy of Ukraine. The considered procedure can be used in infocommunication systems to ensure economic security.

articleTitle: The Relevance of Using Message Brokers in Robust Enterprise Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper covers main message broker protocols and the patterns which are used to manage technical problems. The article provides the reader with typical software engineering design issues which might lead to conceptual violations, software non-functional requirements nonconformity, which is high coupling problem, synchronous operation performance loss, and system constituent integration problem. The solutions which come as a result of applying messaging are brought covering each problem above, in particular establishing the communication between loosely coupled applications, researching the application performance speedup with the Amdahl's law and applying Read Model architectural pattern leveraging message brokers capabilities.

articleTitle: Compensator of Trajectory Instabilities of Aviation Radar with Aperture Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A method of compensation for trajectory instabilities of aviation radars with aperture synthesis is proposed. This method allows the further processing of the received signals to consider that the aircraft or the radar carrier is moving along a predetermined trajectory. The estimation of the relative instability of the generator frequency for the microwave range was obtained. It is determined that the exact compensation of trajectory instabilities by measuring this deviation and compensating for it by changing the time interval between the sensing pulses and the received signal is required for each inclined channel. An algorithm for calculating the radar inspection sub-band width is proposed. The use of the proposed method will provide the ability to achieve a resolution better than 4 ... 8 meters in the radar synthesizing aperture in the fluctuations of the trajectory of motion of the radar carrier relative to the line of the specified path more than half the resolution almost regardless of the altitude, the degree of turbulence the operating speed and mass of the radar carrier.

articleTitle: Useful of High Power Microwave Transmitters in Combined Radio Engineering Complexes and the Analysis of Electromagnetic Compatibility of the System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article shows the possibility of using a single transmitter in a mobile combined radio engineering microwave system on a powerful traveling wave tube. The microwave transmission path is common to the two components of the radio engineering microwave system - troposcatter and radio relay. Reduction of the intrinsic noise of a powerful traveling-wave tube of the modernized design made it possible to obtain a higher linearity over a wide frequency range 4.4 ... 6.2 GHz with an output power of 2 ... 3 kW compared to a solid-state microwave amplifier of a cascade assembly. Calculations have shown the possibility of ensuring the electromagnetic compatibility of radio-emitting means that are part of such a microwave radio engineering system.

articleTitle: Assortativity Properties of Scale-Free Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Nodes distribution by degrees is the most important characteristic of complex networks, but not comprehensive one. While degree distribution is a first order graph metric, the assortativity is a second order one. Assortativity coefficient is a measure of a tendency for nodes in networks to connect with similar or dissimilar ones in some way. As a simplest case, assortative mixing is considered according to nodes degree. In general, degree distribution forms an essential restriction both on the network structure and on assortativity coefficient boundaries. The problem of determining the structure of SF- networks having an extreme assortativity coefficient is considered. The estimates of boundaries for assortativity coefficient have been found. It was found, that these boundaries are as wider as scaling factor of SF-model is far from one of BA-model. In addition, the boundaries are narrowing with increasing the network size.

articleTitle: Radio Antennas for a Forecast of Solar Activity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Simultaneous observations of three small radio telescopes RT-3, RT-2 and RTM, covering the range from 0.66 cm to 1.05 m, will allow obtaining information for analysis of energy release in the solar atmosphere, diagnostics of eruptive solar plasma and short-term forecast of solar activity. The implementation of this radio astronomy project allowed Ukraine to enter the international network of the Sun Service.
