Detected acceleration of growth the surface temperature of the earth in "Nikitsky Botanical Garden" after 1988. Based on the analysis of ground measurements of temperature: the air at a height of 2 m and the Earth's surface for the period from 1930 by 2014, discusses the possible causes of the acceleration. The tendency of variation of the secular variations of the geomagnetic declination in the Kara-Dag point is determined similar to the tendency of the northern component of the velocity of the northern geomagnetic pole to change: reaching a maximum value of about 2000, the trend sign changes to the opposite one.

articleTitle: Access Control System Based on Radioelectronic Elements and the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article devoted to creating a prototype of an access control and management system based on radioelectronic elements the concept of the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: A New Technique of Image Enhancement by Equalizing the Bivariate Probability Density of Brightness
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Histogram equalization is the most well-known intensity transformation technique and is widely used to enhance images owing to high efficiency, simplicity, and low computational cost. However, the traditional approach to image histogram equalization has a number of disadvantages, which significantly limit the possibilities of its use for images enhancement in automatic mode. In this paper, we propose a new technique of image intensity transformation based on equalizing the bivariate probability density of brightness. This approach provides effective image enhancement without the appearance of unwanted artifacts. A generalized description for intensity transformation based on equalizing the joint bivariate brightness distribution is presented. The relationship between the proposed generalized description and the traditional definition of histogram equalization is shown. The proposed technique provides an increase in the efficiency of image enhancement compared to the traditional technique of histogram equalization.

articleTitle: The Forming Professionally Oriented German Communicative Competence of Future Managers in Tourism with the Help of Virtual Moodle System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The research explores the specific features of training as applied to developing professionally oriented German communicative competence of future tourism managers on the base of the MOODLE distance platform. The following scientific methods were employed to achieve set objectives: the comparison and system analysis of pedagogical, methodological sources, positive experience of professionally oriented training of future tourism professionals aimed at enhancing a second foreign language learning, and education process monitoring. The article also included a pilot training to prove the effectiveness of applying professionally oriented methodological tasks. The findings allowed systematizing existing scientific concepts and strategies behind the withdrawal algorithm in learning a second foreign language using Moodle support. The procedure of defining the strategy steps in teaching a second foreign language after English using the authors'` technologies can be the subject of further studies.

articleTitle: Portable Device for Monitoring Blood Pressure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Existing portable blood pressure measurement devices do not provide clear information about the human condition and only pulse pressure can be recorded (the difference between systolic and diastolic blood pressure, but not its values). The authors proposed the device based on the combined sensor, which consists of two parts: actuator and pressure sensor. Such device will allow achieving true blood pressure data similar to the manual tonometer data. Our portable device will be useful for hypothyroidism, hypertension, athletes and active people who follow their health.

articleTitle: Real-Time Authentication of Electronic Devices in Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents the results of experimental studies to determine the authentication characteristics of electronic devices. There are given the calculation of the authentication template based on internal electrical noise and the assessment of the authentication effectiveness. Discrete autocorrelation function of internal electrical noise is used for definition identification signs. An automatic authentication system based on the client-server architecture is proposed. The system operates in real time and consists of several software modules. The authentication system is implemented at the software level, an additional device does not require. The system is scalable; its operation does not depend on the channel of information transfer between the device and the server. The proposed system can be used for continuous inventory of electronic devices of a cyber-physical system.

articleTitle: New Approaches to Search the Relations Between Distributed Data in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper describes the author's algorithm for semantic search of related data in large text arrays, as well as the development of a program for its approbation. The algorithm has been tested in several commonly known social networks. The research technique is described, the analysis of the results is carried out, and the disadvantages found are indicated. Further directions of the algorithm development are suggested, as well as possible spheres of its application are described.

articleTitle: Estimation of Technical Quality For MPEG Streaming in LTE Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to the analysis influence of conditions for the receiving of MPEG video signals that are transmitted with streaming over the LTE network and contains the results of authors' research in this direction. The purpose of these studies is to propose possible normative values of LTE common parameters for providing quality of service level at which receiving of MPEG video signals is done without picture impairments. To implement this field study was carried out based on real LTE network and video streaming service with different video resolutions and parameters. As result of study, LTE video service performance was estimated, possible ways of increasing its characteristics were proposed. The obtained results can be used during the technical maintenance and service implementations for LTE based video transmissions, as well as during further research aimed at increasing the efficiency of services of such type.

articleTitle: Devices Model Research Technique of Analogous Front-End for Optical Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In our paper the aim is to adapt the methods of mathematical SPICE modeling to the problems of impedance spectroscopy and to develop new approaches for increasing the efficiency of the research of impedance type signal converters. This approach based on non-harmonic, mainly pulsed signals in the form of a meander for structural simplification and expansion of the frequencies spectrum. This approach can be used for express high-sensitivity and selective detection of biological substances for diagnostic purposes by means of optical sensors.

articleTitle: Design Testbench for Wireless Sensor Network Based on CC2530 Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The object of the research is nodes and testbenches for wireless sensor networks. The article analyzes the requirements for a wireless sensor network node and testbenche. Goal of the research is develop testbench for wireless sensor networks with adaptive concept design of nodes. The hardware components for building test platform for wireless sensor networks were proposed. In addition, test platform for wireless sensor networks was developed as printed circuit board. As a result proposed solution can use for prototype, build and scale wireless sensor network. In node structures for wireless sensor network proposed use modules CC2530. Also peripherals capabilities of CC2530 were analyzed. As one of optimization approach to designing wireless sensor network given the structure of node. Also given report about difference in concept to designing nodes and uses areas. In conclusion, the developed approaches can be used for any application of the wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Chua’s Circuit with Time-Depended Variable Capacitances and Its Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper deals with the study of the parametrically driven Chua’s circuit. We use Lagrangian formalism together with Kirchhoff rules to perform modeling of parametrically driven Chua’s circuit. Such an approach allows us to represent the dynamic of Chua’s circuit by different state variables. This dynamic is described by differential equations in general form for some time-depended boundary functions, which describe the changing of capacitances. Thus, we define a general model for parametrically driven Chua’s circuit. Then this model is used to study Chua’s circuit dynamic with harmonically changed capacitors. We use numerical methods to solve differential equations of modified Chua’s circuit and prove its difference from classical Chua’s circuit. This difference is proven in time and frequency domains. Our studies show that chaotic oscillations in modified Chua’s circuit are nonlinear ones in the time domain and they have high-frequency harmonics in its harmonic spectrum. We plot 3D attractors of modified and classical Chua’s circuits, which prove circuits’ difference as well. We offer to avoid considering nonlinear functions while the synchronization controller is being designed by using minimal and maximal values of these functions only and constructing an interval model for Chua’s circuit. Combination of this model and feedback linearization methods allows us to design a simple sliding mode feedback controller, which transform the dynamic of Chua’s circuit into Brunovsky form. We use the simplest first order sliding mode controller in the control system feedforward to perform synchronization of the transformed object’s dynamic with an external signal.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Noise Immunity of Signal Reception Algorithms in the MIMO System in the Channel with Dispersion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, we consider suboptimal signal reception algorithms, such as Zero Forcing (ZF), Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) and the algorithm Reception a Whole with Elementwise Decision (RWED) in memory channels using Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO). At the same time, phase modulation signals (BPSK) and QAM-16 signals with an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing system (OFDM) are considered as a transmitted signal. The results of the simulation of the MIMO system with these signals in the channel with memory for various system configurations are presented.

Author Keywords: OFDM Reception a whole with elementwise decision (RWED)

articleTitle: Navigation Support Method Taking into Account Urban Canyon Limitations for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The primary purpose of this work is to create an application to help navigate for people with visual impairments in using urban transport. The relevance of the topic was established by analyzing the transport accessibility for people with visual impairments. As a result, a list of user requirements was determined. Analysis of the market and available analogs revealed the main advantages and disadvantages of existing software systems. The basis of the architectural decision is the principle of responsibility distribution. The software was created using the following technologies: Google Cloud Service, Google Speech-To-Text, Google Geocode API, Google Directions API, Google Maps API, Xamarin, Firebase, ASP.NET MVC.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of User Responses of Tourist Services
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the research the method of tonality analysis was used to find thoughts in the text and determine their properties. The tonality is considered the position of the author on the topic (usually "positive" or "negative") Content analysis of user's responses using corps managers has been applied. This gives grounds to claim that based on the proposed technology it is possible to track the users responses of tourist services and to formulate recommendations for tourism firms for improvement of their activity. The application of sentiment analysis is aimed to improve the tourism industry.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Realization of a Web-Resources Professional Medical Periodic Edition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of informatization of Ukrainian periodicals is important for solving a number of tasks concerning the development, discussion and implementation of scientific information messages. The object of the study was the development and implementation of a web presentation of a professional medical periodical. The aim of the work is to develop a model for the Internet presentation of a scientific periodical and to study the impact of the introduction of this resource on the process of accompaniment to scientific periodicals. The concept of informatization of scientific medical periodicals is studied. At the first stage, the structure of the information resource model was developed; software algorithm was created; the mechanism of implementation and determination of methodological approaches to the estimation of investment efficiency in the development of the information system was worked out. The foundations for the creation of websites of periodicals and requirements of legislative institutions was taken into consideration and a model of a web resource consisting of six modules: Journal, Current issue, Indexation, Archives, For Authors, Contacts was offered. The main modules consist of the following elements: Advisory Board, Editorial Board, History of the Journal, Archives of the issues of the journal, Editorial Policy, General Remarks, Procedure for Submission, Declaration of Publication Ethics, Conflict of Interest Disclosure Form. AS4U software products to implement the developed algorithm were selected. The statistical indexes of the particular website for five years (2014-2018) were used to study the effect of the website of periodical publication on filling the content of the journal and to expand the communications of the scientific community. The implementation of the second stage of the Internet product development has begun, and its purpose is to present the professional periodical to the international scientific-metric databases. The website www.aml.lviv.ua was developed and introduced to the professional medical periodical "Acta Medica Leopoliensia / Lviv Medical Journal", the founder of which is Danylo Halytsky Lviv National Medical University. The website is in four languages: Ukrainian, English, Polish, Russian. The influence of the Internet resource development and its influence on the journal content filling and the expansion of scientific communications has been analyzed. The implemented model of the website has shown a positive impact on the expansion of the possibilities of scientific communication. The availability of content of the periodical has simplified the process of preparation and presentation of scientific messages. The selected software allows the editorial staff of the magazine to to work online to fill the website independently, without any help, enabling the content to be quickly and effectively adjusted, and the system of passwords provides access to content and gives protection of information and can be accessed to any time and anywhere.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Characteristics of Broadband Access Systems Using G.Fast Technology over TPP Type Multi-Pair Telephone Cable
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper analytical expressions of the signal-to-noise ratio, which allow estimating the transmission rate of the transmission systems by G.fast technology when operating over multi-pair telephone cables in case of the crosstalk absence, taking into account the crosstalk for transmission systems not covered by the "vectoring" algorithm and covered by the "vectoring' algorithm. The results of the simulation of parallel operation up to 100 G.fast TS over the TPP-0.4 type multi-pair cables taking into account the degradation of its characteristics are given. The maximum transmission rate of the G.fast TS was determined in the absence of the external noise and crosstalk. The crosstalk influence on the transmission rate without using the "vectoring" algorithm and using the "vectoring" algorithm in the absence of the external noise and under the influence of external interference is estimated. The influence of the multi-pair cable characteristics degradation on the achievable transmission rate using the vectoring algorithm and without using it is estimated.

articleTitle: Usage of Discrete Particle Swarm Optimization Method for the Searching of Optimal Tile Size
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper considers actual methods of the software optimizations. Main attention is directed to the tiling method and parallelization. Showing the opportunities of the tiling method authors accent that tile size of the tiling method has critical influence of the optimization level. Main part of the paper dedicated to the searching of the optimal tile sizes for the better execution time of the test program. As a conclusion authors demonstrate results of the reducing execution time by applying of the particle swarm optimization method for the searching of the optimal tile sizes. The obtained results reveal that particle swarm optimization method can be used for the optimal tile size search. In the same time, parameters of the particle swarm optimization method should be picked up carefully for the faster method search.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Transposition Chaotic Encryption System Based on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays for Multimedia Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the paper, the mathematical model of memory consumption and through-put parameter estimation of a cryptographic system that employs transposition chaotic maps is investigated. The target platform for the system implementation is Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) devices. The proposed mathematical model takes into account limitations of FPGA circuits and can be used to assess usage of FPGA memory resources preliminary and to evaluate throughput efficiency of the encryption system. First, expressions for memory consumption are introduced. The second part is devoted to analysis of the system throughput. Different architectures for memory organization have been considered in the paper as well as all stages of the cipher pipeline. The architectures are characterized by the different level of parallelism on the level of message processing that results in variations in throughput value. The work presents generalized expression for throughput estimation for all the considered cipher architectures. It allows the designer of the system to select an FPGA die that fulfills the basic requirements for cryptographic system implementation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Approaches to Use Wireless Sensors Networks in Design of the Spinal Traction Therapy Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Wireless sensors networks is new technology, that can solve the problem of data transmission from multiple sensors in modern medical equipment. Robotic hardware and software system for diagnosis and treatment of spine diseases using traction therapy was proposed. In this paper we will discuss using wireless sensors network in the traction therapy system, its advantages and disadvantages, and also the field of practical implementation for this technology. In general, traction therapy system allows to use customized traction algorithms, brings the treatment quality to a new level and makes patient's life better.

articleTitle: Means for Measuring Control of Impulsive Overvoltage Caused by Thunderstorms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The analysis of national normative and technical requirements of the lightning protection systems shows the necessity of additional protecting measures from the direct strike of lightning or voltage induction by a remote discharge by determining protective devices choice and charts of their settings. The protection of information and communication systems and their electronic devices components is particularly dependent on the thunderstorms in the environment. Methods of calculation and protecting schemes from impulsive overvoltage recommended by international standards of IEC, are more hard and reliable. Therefore, it is proposed to apply in the circuits of protection against impulse overvoltage means of measurements. The proposed means for measuring control detects and fixes impulse deviations from sinusoidal form of network voltage. On this basis the application schemes of control devices for impulsive overvoltage are complemented, that substantially reduces the risk of fires and electronic device damage from thunderstorm origin. Implementation in the field of operation and maintenance of electronic and telecommunication equipment is proposed.

articleTitle: Application of Modern Internet Technologies in Telemedicine Screening of Patient Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The authors set a goal to analyze the state of use of the achievements of modern Internet technologies in relation to the tasks of telemedicine screening of patients' condition and to study the possibility of determining ways to improve the quality of telemedicine services by creating modern telemedicine complexes. To achieve this goal, it is proposed to review best practices in this area of leading world countries and analyze the specifics of conducting telemedicine screening for various categories of patients in order to determine the main directions for improving telemedicine services in Ukraine. The specific proposals are considered for the implementation of telemedicine screening complex on the application of regional telemedicine means MedStar Solusion LLS.

articleTitle: Optimal Traffic Distribution Based on the Sectoral Model of Loading Network Elements
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In practice, mobile network design uses the method of frequency territorial planning. According to existing methods, solution of the problem provides required performance of electromagnetic compatibility for network elements; as a result, it also provides optimal performance of network. This approach, questions of the uniform distribution of traffic among network elements fade into background. As a result, this approach has an impact on both throughput and quality of service. The paper proposes to improve the efficiency of network, in conjunction with use of method of frequency spatial planning, to apply the method of sectoral analysis for optimal distribution loading between base stations. For this purpose, in addition to statistical data of base stations enrich with data of the billing system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Implementation Results of the Distributed Access Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper attempts to create software and hardware complex that can work autonomously and designed to simplify the organization of scientific conferences. The goal of developing a complex is to give an opportunity to attendees of the conference to register to conference sections using radio frequency identification (RFID) tags and collect statistics of sections attendance in real time. The paper describes the development process of the complex, problems that encounters during the development process and ways to fix it.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity in the Blockchain Era : A Survey on Examining Critical Infrastructure Protection with Blockchain-Based Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Cybercriminals and nation-state hackers are investing heavily in strategies devised to disrupt critical infrastructure systems. Nearly one out of two Industrial Control System (ICS) computers in the energy sector had been impacted by malicious cyber activity in 2018. With threats increasing and attack vectors expanding, critical infrastructure sectors like energy need to implement innovative technology to ensure Critical Infrastructure Protection. This study reviewed blockchain research published between 2015 and 2019 in order to examine the development of blockchain, evaluate current applications of blockchain in the energy sector, and propose additional opportunities for the application of blockchain technology. Quantitative analysis revealed that blockchain-based cybersecurity research and application in the energy sector is increasing at an annual average growth rate of 169% since 2015 with intensified focus on Internet of Things (IoT) and Smart Grid infrastructures. Computed projections forecast a continued increase in the research and application of IoT and Smart Grids. Calculations indicate that nearly 50% of the new research will be in blockchain-based cybersecurity solutions such as cryptographic communications and secure email. Qualitative analysis indicates potential for blockchain- based cybersecurity solutions to provide enhanced Critical Infrastructure Protection in those sectors against pervasive phishing and social engineering threats.

articleTitle: Approaches for Safety-Critical Embedded Systems and Telecommunication Systems Design for Avionics Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The wide application of FPGA chips becomes a trend in telecommunications and wireless communications era. Proposed approaches for safety-critical embedded systems and telecommunication systems design for avionics based on FPGA. In this paper, we will analyze the different approaches to security and safety in embedded systems for avionics. In addition, we analyze the different approaches to safety-critical embedded systems and for avionics based on FPGA. Avionics is an advanced and integrated system that has strong requirement of flexibility, high bandwidth, and stringent end-to-end latency. In article analyzed the avionic wireless network and fly-by-wireless concepts also.

articleTitle: Models, Methods and Algorithms of Web System Architecture Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The algorithm of transfer of computational load without application of additional reserve resources and having offered innovative model of the organization of communication of modules within the limits of one knot and system as a whole is considered. The essence of the model is that the software is divided into logical modules, that is, by its purpose. The architecture of the Web-system is designed so that the modules contain as little logic as possible, because the main task of load redistribution is to support the system in balance. The second requirement for the software architecture is to avoid strong connectivity. Therefore, it is necessary to divide the system into small modules that work with one or a small number of "parent" modules. In the developed model, the modules are isolated from each other and do not have a general condition, but between them you can establish communication and receive notifications about their condition. Asynchronous message exchange is used for interaction of modules. An important aspect of the research is that additional free resources can be found within the existing capabilities of the Web-system.

articleTitle: Formal Methods for Solving Technological Problems in the Infocommunications Routines of Intelligent Decisions Making for Drilling Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The proposed infocommunications routines for intellectual system based on constraints allows to conduct diagnostics of solutions to a technological problem (extraordinary unsheduled situation in drilling) submitted by the object of the decision support and on the basis of such analysis to generate the corresponding feedback. The feedback provides the benefits of a long-term and short-term decision-making process by reviewing the false knowledge of the oil and gas subject area submitted by the decision support object. An additional advantage of the constraints-based approach is the avoidance of detailed study and classification of errors made by decision support object, who tend to systematically use some unified procedure to solve current tasks. Each object uses one of the class of procedures that can be used for a certain class of tasks and the strategy of choosing procedures from the corresponding equivalence class and depends on the current task. Interfaces support the solution of a technological problem by visualizing its structure. When forming a request, the decision support system carries out a synchronous search using the keywords entered and highlights the errors in which such words are found, thus facilitating the choice of the object. Modeling on the basis of the analysis of the errors of the decision support object determines that for the study of the technological process of drilling of oil and gas wells, the significance of declarative knowledge are the dominant. Each constraint on the system has one or more predefined feedback messages that are provided to the object when the constraint is violated.

articleTitle: Development of Genetic Methods of Network Pharmacy Financial Indicators Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The genetic method of multicriteria optimization with modification of the mutation operator is proposed, which is intended to solve the problem of optimization of pharmacies' financial indicators by means of evolutionary methods in the field of pharmacy business, by optimizing the process of work of the drug procurement department. Three modifications of the mutation operator were developed. A system for solving the problem of optimization of pharmacies' financial indicators as a function of the distribution of commodity groups in the pharmacy's assortment is determined, which determines such a percentage distribution of the group of goods in which the conditions will be fulfilled.

Author Keywords: minimization of stock in warehouse time

articleTitle: Investigation of Architecture and Technology Stack for e-Archive System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This work describes main concepts of architecture style and technologies selection for building distributed e-Archive system. The paper presents overall concepts, vocabulary, data models, responsibilities that an electronic archive system must fulfill, and a set of recommended functions to cover these responsibilities. The article describes the main information flows and functions. It outlines the theory of the OAIS model, illustrates an example of complex microservices architecture design and approaches to solve data consistency and application deployment challenges. The comparative analysis of software architecture styles was performed and, as result, the combination of Microservice and Event-Driven architectures was chosen as the most suitable architecture for building electronic archive system. It implies having microservices that communicate with each other via some message bus instead of direct calls. The technology stack chosen for that architecture implementation and application delivery is proven to be production-ready, has detailed documentation and large community support. The technology stack is Asp .Net Core 2.1 - framework, Rabbit MQ, Apache Tika, Elasticsearch, Mongo DB, MS SQL Server, Azure Blob Storage, Event Store, Signal R, Docker, Kubernetes.

articleTitle: The Solution of the Problem of the Delay Determination in the Information Transmission and Processing in the LEO Satellite Internet of Things System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The issues of the Low-Earth-orbit (LEO) Satellite Internet of Things (IoT) System construction based on the Distributed Satellite architecture with Nano-satellites / CubeSats and the Fog Computing concept application have been considered. For the Fog Computing realization, Satellite-Computers are comprised into each Distributed Satellite. Satellite-Computers form the Orbital Distributed Computing Network. The correlation between the parameters of the Satellite System Constellation and the IoT data transmission and processing delay value in the Orbital Distributed Computing Network has been considered. The Distributed Localized Database has been proposed to be placed on the basis of the Orbital Distributed Computing Network. The Generalized Database Structure and its Conservative and Operational parts purpose were defined. Data transfer directivity through the Orbital Segment of the LEO Satellite IoT System was considered for the Localized Database Operational part update and for the Computational Load balancing through the Orbital Distributed Computing Network. The parameters influence of the Orbital Segment of the LEO Satellite IoT System on the Computational Load balancing through the Orbital Distributed Computing Network has been shown. Analytical expressions are given to evaluate the expected round trip time and processing of IoT information in the LEO Satellite IoT System, as well as to form an Information Processing Priority Criterion for the overload balancing, based on the Accaptable Delay Value of processing of IoT Service Information, which is a critical parameter of each IoT Service.

articleTitle: Methodological Solutions for the IoT Concept for Biogas Production Using the Local Resource
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The issue of providing biogas reactors with raw materials of vegetable origin is considered. It is proposed to organize the collection of raw materials on the basis of the concept of the IoT, which combines technical solutions for obtaining information and strategies for its processing. Innovation in maximizing profits is the use of raw materials for biogas reactors of grain crops, the further cultivation of which is economically inappropriate. The predicted low quality of cereals is primarily due to a shortage of nitrogen feed, the assessment of which is proposed to be carried out with the help of UAV. The questions were concerning the metrological support of the sensory equipment with the use of cameras with standard and infra-red lenses are considered. A laboratory evaluation of spectral channels was performed on an example of a camera GoPro HERO4. Prospective indexes for cultivating crops are presented, for example, corn and continuous seeding on wheat. The expediency of using in the construction of stress indices for UAV integral indexes that takes into account both spectral and dimensional parameters of plantations of grain crops is proved. Separate consideration is given to the choice of the optimal routes for combines for harvesting plantings in fields based on electronic maps obtained with the use of UAVs. The technique of determination of the amount of transport equipment for providing a harvesting campaign is proposed.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Quality of Backup Copy Systems Data in Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article deals with a number of issues associated with software quality evaluation. The method for the quality evaluation of data backup systems based on an example of open source software, taking into account the needs of the end consumer, which provide the determination of indicators based on the typical functionalities.

articleTitle: Strategic Priorities for Combating Corruption under Conditions of Global Financial and Economic Challengers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Socio-economic transformations, the globalization of world economic relations, the integration of Ukraine's economy into the European economic space provoke the emergence of a number of crisis phenomena and destabilizing factors in the country which have a negative impact on both the socio-economic development of the country and the society living standards. Among the most common and dangerous at the present stage are corruption and shadow economy. Today it is observed an important problem to search methods for estimation and combating corruption in the context of global financial and economic challenges. The main problems of the spread of corruption in Ukraine are indentified and the factors that directly affect it are explored in the article. A comparative analysis of the most common methods of combating corruption is carried out. The alternative methods of combating corruption in Ukraine are proposed: to intensify the implementation of the Concept of Corruption in Ukraine, to increase the opportunities and conditions for conducting small and medium-sized businesses in the official sector of the economy, to implement a mandatory justification for the sources of cash origin when purchasing goods the cost of which exceeds a predetermined amount (real estate, vehicles and luxury goods), this will allow to hold the process of combating corruption transparently and comprehensive, will allow to strengthen the competitiveness of the economy legal sector, and to achieve high indicators of socio-economic development of the country and society.

articleTitle: Small and Medium Business Structures Clustering Method Based on Their Digital Maturity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Business adaptation and transformation, driven by the challenges of the digital world, is an important point in addressing the challenges of the global market today. To evaluate the effectiveness of digital business transformation, an in-depth analysis of statistical information collected over a given period of time for a particular group of business entities is required. The proposed scientific study concerns the digital transformation of business structures registered in the Ternopil region of Ukraine. The method for researching the level of digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises is developed by conducting a survey and further dividing respondents into clusters. Some indicators are offered, the method of preparation and processing of data is described, the analysis of results is made.

articleTitle: Features of Signal Processing by Means of LoRa Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper deals with the features of signal processing in receiving devices using LoRa technology. A feature of the technology is the ability to build a radio network for transmitting messages over long distances under the condition of long-term battery operation. The main attention is paid to the study of the influence multipath propagation on the operation of the receiving device. For this purpose, the basic characteristics of the received signal, its frequency properties, the possibilities of spreading the spectrum, encoding and recovering the transmitted information, receiving a packet of individual pulse signals and the quality of packet processing as a whole, as well as the effect of multipath propagation, are studied. The technique for studying a receiver in a confined space with an estimate of the calculated and experimental data is proposed. The studies were carried out according to the "point-to-point" schemes. The test results are given.

articleTitle: A Performance Evaluation of Sensor Nodes in the Home Automation System based on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, a home automation system model was constructed with purpose to investigate of the correlation between the performance of wireless communication, power consumption of the constrained IoT devices and security. The series of experiments were conducted using sensor nodes connected to Arduino microcontroller and an RF 433 MHz wireless communication module. Measurements of the execution time and power consumption of the Arduino during data transfer with different security levels, as well as the analysis of the experimental results, were performed. The results show that the lifetime of the IoT device is determined by the communication speed, sleep mode management and depends on encryption. The obtained results can be used to minimize the power consumption of the device and improve communication efficiency. The results show that applied security reduces the productivity and lifetime of the sensor node not significantly.

articleTitle: Secure Software Developing Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Adverse effects on information in the functioning computer systems of various purpose is carried out in order to violate their confidentiality, integrity and accessibility. These threats arise from software vulnerabilities and result in unauthorized access to data or leakage of sensitive information To solve this problem, firstly, an analysis of the software life cycle was carried out in order to determine the stages of software development. Secondly, taking into account the stages obtained, possible threats to information were identified. A buffer overflow vulnerability was considered as a basic example of a threat. Possible ways of exploiting this vulnerability are given, the pros and cons of detection and counteraction tools are analyzed. As a result, recommendations on the development of safe software are presented, both in general terms and more specific in order to avoid the buffer overflow vulnerability. Having using such recommendations, enterprises could reduce the risk of sensitive information breach and minimize outlane. The results obtained in the paper can also be used to make decisions about the possibility of operating the relevant software.

Author Keywords: secure software development; software development life cycle

articleTitle: Development of a Model for the Task of Managing the Operation of a Service-Oriented Information System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The relevance of solving the problem of managing the operation of service-oriented information systems is determined. Research has been carried out on a number of modern scientific studies in the field of information systems operation management. The aim of the study is formulated as development of a model for the task of managing the operation of a service-oriented information system. The influence of a service-oriented approach on the formal description of the tasks of life cycle processes management is reviewed. A mathematical model of the task of managing the operation of a service-oriented information system has been developed. The basis of this model is the formal descriptions of requests for changes from system services. As a formal description of the request for change is proposed to use a knowledge-oriented model of this request. Description of the purpose functions and constraint systems of the formulated management task is highlighted. The main features are considered and the groups of information technology services built on the basis of the developed model are highlighted.

Author Keywords: service oriented information system; request for change

articleTitle: Adaptable Text Corpus Development for Specific Linguistic Research
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Thesis deals with automated corpus development techniques for specific linguistic research purposes. Different corpora and corpus toolboxes available today have been overviewed. Corpus tool functionality for processing custom and private text purposes and automated corpora building system capabilities has been classified. Lack of analytical means which decrease effectiveness, multifunctionality and adaptability in overviewed corpora has been illustrated (impossibility of FrameNet usage, lack of detailed statistics and other relevant issues). Main stages of source data text processing have been reviewed. Natural language processing and natural language understanding methods and tools for adaptable corpora building have been examined and justified. General workflow and design of adaptable text corpus software tool are suggested. Adaptable text corpus software prototype for specific linguistic research purposes has been developed. Big Data and text search engine approaches have been implemented in the prototype.

articleTitle: Routing Tensor Model with Providing Multimedia Quality
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Routing tensor model with providing multimedia quality is proposed. The novelty of the proposed model lies in providing a given level of Quality of Experience regarding the multimedia quality indicator. Due to implementation of the tensornetwork analysis functional, it was possible to provide an analytical calculation of key parameters that influence the multimedia quality level: packet loss probabilities for audio and video flows, as well as the average end-to-end packet delay for the same flows transmitted within the multimedia session. The possibility of analytical and interconnected calculation of these QoS indicators allows to control the impact of desynchronization in time during delivery processes of packets of audio and video flows on multimedia quality, which is significant in the practical implementation of the proposed routing model.

articleTitle: Counteracting Malicious Insider’s Activity within Funds Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The developed classification characteristics of insiders on the level of access and classification characteristics of their actions allowed to formalize the mathematical apparatus for constructing an insider action model on the basis of the international standard of the IDEF0 functional modeling methodology, to generate input information for the created model, and also to perform the decomposition of the 1st and 2nd levels model. The model is based on the statement that usual insiders work on the same algorithms. The difference arises only due to the specific nature of the enterprise's activities. Based on the above algorithm of actions of insiders, a scheme of actions of insiders at the enterprise was developed.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Forecasting Model of Changes Based on Impacts in Infocommunication Projects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The issues related to the development of cloud technologies are considered, in particular, the development and implementation of distributed information systems, which today are the most important decision in the market of information technologies. The reasons for the negative conclusion of most such projects are analyzed, the conclusion is made on the necessity of applying to these processes the technologies of project management that are sufficiently developed and effective at this time. The analysis is carried out to study the parameters and characteristics of projects for the creation of complex infocommunication products and the main causes of project failures based on the generated classes of influences are identified. A list of top-level dynamic changes has been generated that made it possible to determine the main impacts on all components and participants of project activities. A multi-level conceptual model of influences and their actions on the parameters of such projects is built. A mathematical model of project state forecasting is formulated based on this using a proactive approach. Using the method of expert estimation, the authors conducted a study of the proposed model and showed the results of these studies. Practical implementation of such models in information and communication projects has shown its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Ensembling Clustering Method for Evaluating of the Economic Security Components. Case Study: The Regions of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article focuses on the economic security of the Ukrainian regions and the evaluation of its components, which are classified into groups of socio-economic indicators of the region's development, quality of life of the population of the regions and the use of ICT (information-communication technologies) in the regions. In this article, we propose an ensembling clustering method, which allows automatically selecting a clustering method on the basis of optimization of the aggregating functional of internal clustering quality indexes. After preliminary estimation of the clusterability, the choice of the optimal method is performed on the set of specified methods and metrics of measuring the dissimilarity of objects. The article presents an approbation of the proposed method using the example of evaluating separate components of the economic security of Ukrainian regions and presents the empirical results of the implemented method.

articleTitle: One Way of Testing of Pseudorandom Sequence of Small Length Using Multidimensional Statistics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Existing approaches to testing pseudorandom sequences, their advantages and disadvantages are considered. It is revealed that for sequences of length up to 100 bits there are not enough existing statistical packets. The available techniques show low flexibility and versatility in the means of finding hidden patterns in the data. Perspective direction of research - static testing of sequences using n-dimensional statistics is considered. To solve this problem, it is suggested to use algorithms based on multidimensional statistics. In the work, formulas are given and theorem for testing sequences for randomness, using two or three-dimensional statistics that can be used for small and medium-sized sequences is formulated. The new technique of PRS testing is proposed in the paper, and several criteria for testing bit sequence of small length are considered, which, in comparison with one-dimensional statistics, gives a more accurate result.

articleTitle: Classification of Routing Protocols for FANTS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are the area of growing interest for the researchers and its different applications and facilities are in use. As for the automation of UAVs, or as the solution to form the ad hoc connected occasions when finishing complex work, suggests it appears to be effective in shaping these lines with a flying ad hoc network (FANET). Even if like Mobile Ad hoc Network (MANET) and Vehicular Ad hoc Network (VANET), FANETs has its own properties. One of the contradictions in principle is that the UAV is directed at all, but especially when sorted - they are mission-oriented, and their mobility models are often guided by their central goal and due to the idea of assignments received. We proposed relative investigations in view of various measures and explain about the points of interest and hindrances of every protocol. Further, new difficulties for later study are displayed, which will recommend the new kind of coordination between existing UAVs and VANETS. This overview of innovation is that it caters to the existing reviews on the same topic and gives more subtle elements on specific viewpoints communicated just in other bibliographic studies.

articleTitle: Object Detection Method Based on Aerial Image Instance Segmentation in Poor Optical Conditions for Integration of Data into an Infocommunication System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article analyses the possibilities to use the unmanned aerial complexes in the system of decision making process in crisis situations that require the object detection at aerial images received by the unmanned aerial complexes under the conditions of atmospheric fog. The Pansharpening method was used for image correction to inject spatial details from panchromatic image to multidimensional image. In order to increase the operational efficiency and accuracy of automotive vehicles detection at aerial images received by the unmanned aerial complexes for more efficient use of received information in the system of decision making support it was selected the Cascade Mask R-CNN model. This model is more suitable for task solution of multiclass classification and small-sized object detection at the image. To improve this model it is suggested using the small-sized anchors making into account the aspect ratio to more classes, function focal loss for model training that along with test time augmentation use enabled to increase mean Average Precision (mAP).

articleTitle: Art Market Investment Security Modelling and Blockchain Technologies Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The challenge addressed in this research is to develop an Art Market Investment Security (AMIS) system that would consider risks inherent in the external and internal environment of art industry. Application of such system grants more effective preventing and eliminating the effects of threats and destabilizing forces on the interests of all types of stakeholders on the art market. The proposed approach to AMIS focuses on measuring a multicriteria comprehensive indicator, calculated on the base on the multilevel integration synthesizing a set of chosen parameters. Close attention is paid to blockchain technology as a useful tool able to improve the level of financial and economic security of investment strategies on the art market.

articleTitle: Economic Security Governance and Financial Independence of Telecommunication Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper considers the main problems of the telecommunications industry in the area of economic security within its administrative and legal regulation. The paper examines economic security as a subject of administrative and legal regulation. The authors have analyzed the conceptual basis of administrative and legal regulation of economic security. The authors have identified threats to the economic security of telecommunication companies. The paper analyzes the legal regulation in the field of the economic security of telecommunication companies under the competition conditions and transition to a financially independent industry. The authors have proposed the directions of improvement of the administrative and legal regulation of the economic security of telecommunication companies, namely, advanced financial analysis as a guarantee of timely detection and prevention of the financial problems and assessing the preconditions in establishing a financially independent telecommunications industry.

articleTitle: Development of Models for Predicting the Nickel Exchange Price with the Necessary Accuracy for Metal Trading Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The state of the world market of metals is one of the main indicators of the global economy state as a whole, as it is a raw material that is actively used in the information and communication technologies. This explains the urgency of the challenges companies in this sector are facing. One of these is the prediction of metal prices to make the right decisions in the industry. The article aims to en light a strategy, which implies the necessary steps for forecasting and presents a search for a suitable forecasting model, the accuracy of which satisfies the goals of steel trading companies. Firstly, the authors analyze the forecast and its accuracy based on common statistical forecasting models, such as the pair regression equation or a linear function for a time series, models reduced to the linear ones, namely, the polynomials of 2, 3 and 4 degrees, etc. Further, the author presents a quality criterion of forecasting for stock metals prices to support the decisions made by the steel trader. It is this criterion that proved the need to develop the most accurate forecasting models, which was actually done. New models are based on both technical and fundamental analysis of stock quotes of metals, and have the accuracy necessary to be applied in practice by steel trading companies to trade successfully.

Author Keywords: standard statistical models of time series forecasting
investors’ expectation regarding the future asset prices in the commodity market
the quality criterion of the forecast model
the share of correctly predicted price movements

articleTitle: Semantic Radar Technology for Detecting and Recognizing Low-Visible Air Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents the information technology of low-visible air objects radar detection developed by formalizing the processes of perception and transformation of signals and signal images, taking into account the possibilities of unification of procedures for inter-period and multi-survey (multi-view) radar signals processing and information based on semantic analysis. It is also proposed to accumulate the energy and semantic component of the signal information by forming space-time images using the algebra of finite predicates.

articleTitle: Using of Machine Learning Algorithms without Preliminary Training in Unconstant Game Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article contains a comparative analysis of the effectiveness of machine learning algorithms in finding optimal strategy by result in a competitive environment without the possibility of prior training using an example game based on the dilemma of the prisoner. Results of using of adaptive algorithms in comparison with constant strategies are considered from the point of view of game design. Based on the data obtained, the article offers a set of approaches for implementing an adaptive gaming environment as an alternative to the decision trees which are often used in videogame programming.
